items.title: ICE detains former Venezuelan boxing champion Jorge Linares in Texas
items.brief: Former Venezuelan boxing champion Jorge Linares is in the custody of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement after immigration authorities detained him Sunday in El Paso, Texas, according to Linares and his legal counsel.

items.title: Exclusive: Highly classified US national security communications network goes down, sources say
items.brief: The highly classified network that the National Security Agency uses for its internal communications is down, according to six people familiar with the matter.

items.title: ‘Human’ revealed as Cambridge Dictionary Word of the Year for 2026
items.brief: Amid the global debate surrounding artificial intelligence, Cambridge Dictionary has named “human” as its Word of the Year for 2026.

items.title: Nvidia rules out Jensen Huang’s return as CEO, tells investors ‘we’ve got this’
items.brief: Nvidia’s board unanimously accepted former CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation and does not intend to reinstate him as chief executive, board chair Harvey Jones said at the start of the company’s earnings call Tuesday night.

items.title: Suspect faces federal charges after explosive device found at Illinois ethanol plant
items.brief: A suspect faces federal charges in connection with an explosive device found Friday at a central Illinois ethanol plant, according to a law enforcement official and an indictment in the case.
